p16275768181061.descriptionHtml:
Quiet statement. Heavy comfort. Heavyweight brushed-fleece sweatpants in a soft Dust tone, finished with a single black Japanese calligraphy character at the lower leg. Minimal on purpose — the kind of piece you reach for on rest days, late walks and everything in between.

Why you'll wear it

  • Brushed fleece interior that stays warm and soft wash after wash
  • Relaxed, boxy streetwear cut that drapes instead of clings
  • Side-seam pockets that hold your phone without adding bulk
  • Interior drawcord and elastic cuffs to dial in the fit and stack cleanly over sneakers

Fit

Relaxed and roomy. Take your usual size for the intended oversized look, or size down for a closer fit.

Fabric & details

  • Heavyweight 60% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, 40% polyester fleece (Athletic Heather: 94% cotton, 6% polyester)
  • Brushed fleece interior
  • Side-seam pockets
  • Interior drawcord, elastic leg cuffs

Care

Machine wash cold, inside out, with similar colours. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Don't iron directly on the print.

seo.title: Japanese Calligraphy Sweatpants – Heavyweight Fleece | IZAVEN

p16275849216325.descriptionHtml:
Second skin for hard sessions. A slim, long-sleeve rash guard built for training, grappling, surfing and everything outdoors. Four-way stretch moves with you, flat seams stay out of the way, and the longer cut keeps you covered when you reach, roll and lift.

Why you'll wear it

  • Four-way stretch fabric that stretches and snaps back on every axis
  • Flat seams and coverstitch — no rubbing under pressure
  • Longer body and sleeves that stay put through every rep and roll
  • Helps shield your skin from sun, wind and sand

Fit

Compression-style and fitted — it runs small. For a more comfortable fit we recommend going one size up.

Fabric & details

  • 78% polyester, 22% elastane (US fulfillment)
  • 84% polyester, 16% elastane (EU fulfillment)
  • Fabric weight: 8.56 oz/yd² (290 g/m²) US · 6.78 oz/yd² (230 g/m²) EU
  • Very soft four-way stretch fabric
  • Longer body and sleeves
  • Flat seam and coverstitch
  • Blank components sourced from Mexico and China

Care

Rinse thoroughly in fresh water after every use to remove chlorine and salt. Machine wash cold, inside out, on a gentle cycle. Skip the fabric softener and bleach. Hang to dry — the stretch and print last longest away from the dryer.

Good to know

  • Runs small and fitted — size up for a relaxed feel.

seo.description: Slim long-sleeve rash guard with four-way stretch, flat seams and a longer cut. Built for BJJ, surf and training. Runs small — size up. Sizes XS–3XL.

  • Longline cut that doubles as a training top or streetwear layer

Fit

Snug, supportive compression fit. Take your usual size; size up for lighter support.

Fabric & details

  • 78% polyester, 22% elastane (US fulfillment)
  • 74% recycled polyester, 26% elastane (EU fulfillment) — recycled content certified under GRS (Global Recycled Standard)
  • Fabric weight: 8.56 oz/yd² (290 g/m²) US · 7.37 oz/yd² (250 g/m²) EU
  • Lining: 92% polyester, 8% elastane (US) · 90% polyester, 10% elastane (EU); 4.42 oz/yd² (150 g/m²), may vary by 5%
  • Openings for removable padding, fully lined with mesh

Care

Machine wash cold, inside out, on a gentle cycle. Skip the fabric softener and bleach. Hang to dry — the stretch and print last longest away from the dryer.

Good to know

  • Where the fabric is double-layered, details from the inner layer may subtly show through, especially with lighter designs.
  • Avoid rough surfaces — they can pull white fibres from the fabric.

  • Matching soles and laces for a clean, considered look

Fit

True to size. If you're between sizes, go half a size up.

Fabric & details

  • 100% polyester ultralight flyknit upper
  • EVA rubber outsole
  • Breathable lining
  • Soft insole and padded collar
  • Lace-up front
  • Soles and laces in matching colours
  • Blank sourced from China

Care

Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Air dry away from direct heat. Remove the insole to dry faster after a hard session.

Good to know

  • The outsole design varies by size: EU 37.5–40 have a point-like pattern, 40.5–47.5 feature stripes.
  • A strong glue smell is normal on arrival — let the shoes air out for a couple of days and it disappears.
